as_told.title: Attributes in angel hierarchies that match modern alien phenomena

plain: The ranks of angels described by the medieval theologian Thomas Aquinas match much of what people today report from contact with NHI, short for non-human intelligence, which would suggest old religion and modern UFO encounters describe the same thing. Michels says he heard this from Karl Nell, a retired Army colonel, and Diana Pasulka, a scholar of religion, who were both talking about it. In another episode he makes the point in his own voice, adding the ancient philosopher Iamblichus, and says some of these old accounts fit modern reports, giving as an example beings seen with irradiated light.
